events.description: 4. GENERAL ORDER NO. 2022-04: This general order provides for the management and assignment of cases filed by a plaintiff or petitioner without counsel. events.description: 11. MEMORANDUM AND ORDER: Plaintiff's Motion to Extend, Filing No. 10, is granted. Plaintiff shall have through and until November 18, 2024, to submit his $2.96 initial partial filing fee in compliance with the Court's September 20, 2024, Order, Filing No. 8. Plaintiff's October 7, 2024, Motion to Proceed IFP, Filing No. 9, is denied as moot. The Clerk of Court shall terminate the October 21, 2024, initial partial filing fee case management deadline set forth in the Court's September 20, 2024, Order, Filing No. 8, and shall set the following pro se case management deadline of November 18, 2024: initial partial filing fee payment due. Ordered by Senior Judge Joseph F. Bataillon. (Copy mailed to pro se party) (ADB) (Entered: 10/18/2024)

events.description: 13. MEMORANDUM AND ORDER: Plaintiff's Motion to Extend, Filing No. 12, is granted in part. Plaintiff shall have through and until January 17, 2025, to submit his $2.96 initial partial filing fee in compliance with the Court's September 20, 2024, Order, Filing No. 8. The Clerk of Court shall terminate the November 18, 2024, initial partial filing fee case management deadline set forth in the Court's October 18, 2024, Order, Filing No. 11, and shall set the following pro se case management deadline of January 17, 2025: initial partial filing fee payment due. Plaintiff is reminded that to the extent he seeks additional time to comply with this order he must file a written motion with this Court explaining why additional time is needed before the deadline for compliance has passed. Ordered by Senior Judge Joseph F. Bataillon. (Copy mailed to pro se party) (ADB) (Entered: 12/04/2024)

events.description: 14. REASSIGNMENT ORDER (TEXT ONLY) In the interest of judicial economy, a portion of the civil cases assigned to the Pro Se Docket will be reassigned to Senior Judge John M. Gerrard for disposition. Accordingly, this case is reassigned to Judge Gerrard for disposition and remains assigned to the Pro Se Docket for processing of all pretrial matters. Ordered by Chief Judge Robert F. Rossiter, Jr. [COPY MAILED TO PRO SE PARTY] (JLS) (Entered: 01/03/2025)
